Interface GuiScreenAccessor

public interface GuiScreenAccessor
Invokes protected vanilla input callbacks without draining Minecraft's input queue. Call on the client thread inside the hosted screen's scope; coordinates are GUI units.

  • Method Details

    • invokeMouseClicked

      void invokeMouseClicked(int mouseX, int mouseY, int mouseButton) throws IOException
      Delivers a button press to the screen.
      Parameters:
      mouseX - horizontal GUI position
      mouseY - vertical GUI position, measured down from the top
      mouseButton - zero-based vanilla button index
      Throws:
      IOException - if the screen's callback reports an I/O failure

    • invokeMouseMovedOrUp

      void invokeMouseMovedOrUp(int mouseX, int mouseY, int mouseButton)
      Delivers a button release; the historical method name is retained for compatibility.
      Parameters:
      mouseX - horizontal GUI position
      mouseY - vertical GUI position
      mouseButton - released zero-based button index

    • invokeMouseClickMove

      void invokeMouseClickMove(int mouseX, int mouseY, int button, long elapsed)
      Delivers a drag while a button remains down.
      Parameters:
      mouseX - current horizontal GUI position
      mouseY - current vertical GUI position
      button - held zero-based button index
      elapsed - milliseconds since the press began

    • invokeKeyTyped

      void invokeKeyTyped(char typedChar, int keyCode) throws IOException
      Delivers one vanilla keyboard callback, which accepts one UTF-16 character.
      Parameters:
      typedChar - character, or zero for a key without text
      keyCode - legacy LWJGL key code, or zero for text-only delivery
      Throws:
      IOException - if the screen's callback reports an I/O failure
